order_wins: **NCC** -- see Top movers: eight orders received in October totalling Rs 1,862.45 cr (~25.9% of mcap).
**Rbm Infracon** -- see Top movers: Rs 354.76 cr service order from Epitome Industries India (SME; mcap not in store).
**Interarch Building Solutions** -- see Top movers: Rs 67.56 cr aircraft-hangar PEB order from an undisclosed customer (~2.75% of mcap).
**Shayona Engineering** -- see Top movers: three same-day domestic purchase orders totalling Rs 2.17 cr (~3.4% of mcap).

**Cranex** -- receives Letters of Award/Purchase Orders for EOT cranes worth Rs 12.93 cr from Larsen & Toubro (Rs 7.95 cr, for Torrent's Anuppur project), Godawari Power & Ispat (Rs 4.93 cr) and Tarkeswar Enterprise (Rs 0.05 cr) -- filed twice, as a Reg-30 intimation and a press release that rounds the total to Rs 12.88 cr omitting the Tarkeswar order; carried once (~18.6% of mcap).
**Dynamic Services & Security** -- work order from ESI Hospital, Budge Budge (West Bengal Government) to provide 42 personnel from 1-Nov; value not stated in the cached pages.
**Munish Forge** -- Rs 19.18 cr order from Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (Ministry of Defence) for Tracks, delivery by 27-Jul-2027 (~9.7% of mcap).
equity_allotments: **Kamdhenu Ventures (Kamopaints)** -- allots 1.50 cr equity shares at Rs 6.80 (incl. Rs 5.80 premium) to parent Kamdhenu Limited on conversion of warrants issued 20-Mar-2026, Rs 10.20 cr -- our arithmetic -- (warrant conversion past).

**Oscar Global** -- EGM approves a Rs 47.72 cr preferential issue of 4.77 cr equity shares at Rs 10: 3.45 cr shares via share swap to JBCG Advisory Services (proposed promoter/acquirer), for its acquisition of Calculus Travel Ventures, and 1.32 cr shares for cash to two public investors.
**Bikewo Green Tech** -- allots 37.77 lakh equity shares at Rs 31 to promoter and non-promoter warrant holders on conversion of warrants, Rs 11.71 cr -- our arithmetic -- (warrant conversion past).
m_and_a: **Marathon Nextgen Realty** -- Board approves acquiring an additional 60% stake in joint venture Swayam Realtors and Traders (SRTL) for full economic interest in the Monte South Project, Byculla, for up to Rs 135 cr cash plus a Rs 200 cr bank guarantee, totalling up to Rs 335 cr (filed on both exchanges, carried once; a same-day press release separately names the seller as Adani Group).

**Shyam Metalics and Energy** -- Board approves acquiring a 51% controlling stake in Alom Solar Private Limited, which becomes a subsidiary; value not stated in the cached pages (filed twice, carried once).

**Kesar Enterprises** -- terminates its 8-Sep MoU to sell the Baheri (Bareilly) sugar undertaking to Avadh Foods and Multi Warehouse after the buyer defaulted on payments; the undertaking stays with the Company, which will pursue legal action.
**GTPL Hathway** -- extends by 30 days, to 30-Nov, the timeline to complete its acquisition of the balance 74% of DL GTPL Cabnet; other terms unchanged.

**Kalind** -- one board meeting (filed three times): withdraws its Rs 98.99 cr preferential issue after allottees balked at the approved Rs 11.50/share price; approves acquiring Kalind Gems & Diamonds as an unlisted wholly owned subsidiary, value not disclosed; and approves an in-principle, mode-unspecified fund-raising ceiling of up to Rs 500 cr (an enabling resolution, not a raise).
**Devyani International** -- the CCI approves its already-disclosed (26-Aug) Scheme of Arrangement to merge Sapphire Foods India into itself.

**Aurionpro Solutions** -- Board approves amalgamating three wholly owned subsidiaries (Aurofidel Outsourcing, Intellvisions Solutions, Skanan Hardware) into itself, subject to NCLT, shareholder and creditor approvals; value not disclosed.

**EPW India** -- enters an MOU with Spectrum Wireless and Technologies and its group company Denovo Technologies Solutions (refurbished mobile phones/electronics); terms not disclosed in the cached pages.
**Sonalis Consumer Products** -- terminates its 8-Dec-2025 MOU to take over Holkar Somnath Milk & Agro Products; reason not stated in the cached pages.
**Samyak International** -- declared Successful Resolution Applicant for Panda Technologies India's CIRP by the Committee of Creditors; resolution-plan value not stated in the cached pages.

**Aditya Ispat** -- extends to 31-Dec (from 31-Oct) the completion deadline for its related-party slump sale of its non-alloy-steel manufacturing business to promoter-group Jai Bapji Ispat, citing administrative delays.
**Waaree Energies** -- Board approves acquiring 33.34% of Wictor Sealz from Vimac Impex via a Share Purchase-cum-Shareholders' Agreement; value not stated in the cached pages.
**Sizemasters Technology** -- Board approves acquiring 60% (7.86 lakh shares) of Ankita Innovations & Technologies; value not stated in the cached pages.
capex_core: **Shyam Metalics and Energy** -- approves an initial ~Rs 360 cr capex budget to develop the Phutamura Coal Block (Raigarh, Chhattisgarh) via its proposed 51%-held Alom Solar JV; SMEL's own 51% share is ~Rs 183.60 cr, the remaining 49% funded by the JV partner (filed twice, carried once).
**Atlanta Electricals** -- WOS AE Components approves Rs 193.58 cr capex for a new facility to manufacture transformer tanks, frames and radiators (backward integration), ~1-year completion.

**Greenleaf Envirotech** -- forms a JV with Krishna Construction (Gujarat) LLP to execute a Rs 16.80 cr UP Jal Nigam (Gorakhpur) sewage-treatment-plant order, as Lead Partner; JV profit-share ratio not yet fixed.

**Quality Power Electrical Equipments** -- approves Rs 25 cr capex to add oil-filled shunt-reactor manufacturing at its new Global Coil Factory, Sangli; separately reaffirms its already-disclosed (19-Oct EGM-approved) up to Rs 272.34 cr Winwin Speciality Insulators acquisition, still subject to SPA conditions -- not a new raise.
**Acme Solar Holdings Limited** -- ACME Solar Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange about updation on commissioning of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Project
**Dhoot Transmission** -- subscribes to Rs 2.82 cr of fresh equity (EUR 2.50 lakh) in wholly owned subsidiary Dhoot Transmission GmbH.

**Solarworld Energy Solutions** -- pays Rs 26.82 cr as the first equity-subscription tranche to Rays Green Energy Manufacturing (its JV with Rays Power Infra, first disclosed 7-Sep), for 12,600 shares at Rs 21,287 each.
business_updates: **Results season** — 182 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Akme Fintrade (India)** -- press release: AUM crosses the Rs 1,000 cr milestone, up 35% YoY (per the filing's own headline).
**Cantabil Retail India** -- opens 9 new showrooms in October, taking its store count to 699.

**Info-Drive Software** -- post-facto intimation of its 9th Committee of Creditors meeting, held 22-Oct.

**AGS Transact Technologies** -- its 18th Committee of Creditors meeting (e-voting) ratifies insurance costs and valuer fees, sets a tie-breaker formula for equal-vote resolution plans, and extends the CIRP period by 60 days.
**Aditya Infotech Limited** — Aditya Infotech Limited has informed the Exchange about withdrawal of Arbitration Proceedings.

**Panabyte Technologies** -- lapses and forfeits 3.50 lakh promoter-group convertible warrants (Rs 1.68 cr issue, approved Apr-2025) after the balance 75% was not paid by the exercise deadline -- a failed raise, not an allotment.
**DPSC (India Power Corporation)** -- the company under CIRP since May-2026 receives NSE/MSE non-compliance fines under Reg 34; fine amount not stated in the cached pages.

**Ashima** -- withdraws its civil suit against HDFC Bank after a settlement, with the Ahmedabad Commercial Court disposing of it on 30-Oct; a related settlement with Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait is also underway.

**Rolex Rings** -- Care Edge upgrades its bank-facility ratings to CARE A/Stable and CARE A1 from CARE A-/Stable and CARE A2+ (facility size not published per house rule).
